test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 16 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
You are given three statements:

1. All blues are bears.

2. All brides are bears.

3. All brides are children.

Which of the following conclusions is/are true?

A. Some children are bears.

B. Some blues are children.

C. Some blues are brides.

D. Some brides are not children.
solution:
The least possible venn diagram is shown below,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b3b12476187fd3c2fa50ffaffb38047c0dc4c0d37a2dd26d62a226f72990bc65.png] 

**Conclusions:**

A. Some children are bears → **True **(All brides are bears and all brides are children implies that some of those children who are brides are also bears).

B. Some blues are children → **False** (All blues are bears, all brides are bears and all brides are children implies that it is possible that some blues are children but not definite).

C. Some blues are brides → **False** (All blues are bears and all brides are bears implies that it is possible that some blues are brides but not definite).

D. Some brides are not children → **False** (All brides are children implies that it is not possible that some brides are not children).

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
